Where we stand
SEO is the engine. Search now happens across more surfaces than ever — Google organic, local map packs, AI Overviews, AI assistants, and voice. The businesses that win are the ones with the right foundation for all of it. We build that foundation. Measured in leads and revenue, not spreadsheet positions.
OUR PHILOSOPHY
Why this matters now

An SEO agency built for how search works today — and where it's heading.

A few years ago, winning search meant one thing: ranking on Google. That still matters enormously — Google Search and Google Maps remain where the majority of buying decisions begin. We start there, with the technical health, content depth, backlink authority, and local presence that move rankings and drive organic traffic.

What's changed is where search ends. Today's buyer might start on Google, get a summary from AI Overviews, ask ChatGPT for a recommendation, or check Gemini or Perplexity before choosing a provider. If your brand isn't visible across those surfaces, you're losing ground to competitors who are.

The good news: AI visibility is built on the same foundation as SEO. The crawlable pages, structured data, authoritative content, and trusted backlinks that rank on Google are exactly what AI engines draw from. AI SEO isn't a separate discipline — it's what modern SEO looks like when it's done properly. Our job is to build that foundation right — so you win on Google today, and stay visible as search continues to evolve.

01
Foundation
The work that has to happen first
01

Website SEO Audit

A thorough diagnostic of why your website isn't ranking where it should. Most businesses are losing traffic to problems they don't know exist — slow pages, broken links, or content Google can't properly read. We find every issue, explain it in plain language, and tell you exactly what to fix first. You get a clear action plan, not a list of technical problems.

02

Technical SEO

We make sure Google can find, read, and rank every page on your website. A slow or poorly structured site acts as a ceiling on your rankings — no matter how good your content is, it won't perform if Google struggles to access it. We fix the infrastructure so your entire site becomes rankable. Your website stops being a barrier and starts being an asset.

03

On-Page & Content SEO

We optimise every page on your site so it's built to rank for the searches that matter to your business. Buyers search with intent — they're looking for a specific answer or a specific product. We make sure your pages match exactly what they're looking for, in a way Google rewards. More of your pages rank for searches that turn into customers.

02
Authority & Reach
How you out-rank the competition
04

Keyword & Competitor Research

We find the exact searches your potential customers use when they're ready to buy — then build your SEO strategy around those. Most businesses waste time targeting the wrong terms while competitors quietly own the searches that actually drive revenue. We close that gap with a roadmap built on what's winnable and what's worth winning. Your SEO budget goes toward searches that bring buyers, not browsers.

05

Link Building & Digital PR

We earn mentions and links for your business from credible, well-known websites — which Google treats as a vote of confidence in your brand. Without this, even a technically perfect website struggles to outrank established competitors who've built years of credibility online. Every link we build is earned through real outreach, fully transparent, and built to last. Your site gains the kind of authority that moves you past competitors who've been around longer.

06

Local SEO & Google Business Profile

We get your business showing up prominently in Google Maps and local search results when nearby customers are ready to buy. For most local businesses, the map pack at the top of Google is where the majority of enquiries come from — and most businesses aren't optimising for it at all. We build and manage the full local presence that puts you at the top when it counts. More calls, walk-ins, and enquiries from people searching in your area.

03
AI Search & Measurement
The newer layer, included as standard
07
Latest algorithm

AEO — Answer Engine Optimization

We structure your content so Google highlights your business in the answer boxes and AI Overviews that appear above the regular search results. Our AEO services are built around one insight: when a potential customer searches a question in your industry, Google often answers it before they click anything — and that answer box is prime real estate. We position your content to own it. Your business becomes the answer, not just a result.

08
Latest algorithm

GEO — Generative Engine Optimization

We get your business recommended by AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity when users ask them for product or service suggestions. GEO optimization works because a growing number of buyers now ask AI assistants "who's the best [service] near me?" before they ever open Google — and the brands that get recommended are the ones that have built the right signals. We build those signals for you. Your brand gets named by AI tools when buyers in your category are looking for recommendations.

09

Analytics, Tracking & Reporting

We set up clear reporting so you always know what your SEO is producing in real business terms. Too many agencies send reports full of graphs that don't connect to revenue — you end up not knowing whether you're getting a return. Every month you receive a straightforward report covering ranking improvements, traffic growth, lead volume, and how often AI tools are recommending you. You always know what the work is producing — in leads and revenue, not just rankings.

How it works

A five-phase framework that builds rankings and compounds them.

Every engagement follows the same disciplined sequence — because each phase creates the conditions the next one depends on. This is how sustainable search growth is built: methodically, with clear outputs at every stage and results that compound over time.

01
Discovery

SEO Audit & Market Research

We begin by mapping exactly where your business stands — and what's standing between you and the top of Google. We audit your website's technical health, analyse the searches your customers are actually making, and benchmark you against the competitors currently taking traffic that should be yours. You receive a prioritised roadmap with clear recommendations before any ongoing work begins. Outcome: you know precisely what to fix, in what order, and why.

02
Build

Technical Foundation

Before rankings can grow, your website needs to be built in a way that Google can fully access, understand, and trust. We fix the underlying structure — site speed, page architecture, indexation, and mobile performance — so every piece of content you have can actually rank. Most businesses skip this step and wonder why their content isn't working. We don't skip it. Outcome: your website becomes a platform Google can rank with confidence.

03
Grow

Content Authority Building

Rankings are earned by websites Google recognises as genuinely authoritative in their field. We build that authority through strategic content that answers the questions your buyers are asking, combined with credible links from established publications that signal your expertise. This is the phase where your organic presence begins to outpace competitors — and where the compounding effect of SEO starts to show. Outcome: your brand becomes a recognised authority in your category, on Google and beyond.

04
Extend

Google + AI Search Optimization

With a strong SEO foundation in place, we extend your visibility into the AI-powered surfaces your buyers are increasingly using — Google's AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. This isn't a separate product: the content, authority, and structure we've already built are exactly what AI engines draw from. We optimise specifically for how these tools select and cite businesses, so your brand appears at the moment buyers are making decisions. Outcome: you're visible across every surface your buyers use — not just Google.

05
Scale

Growth Measurement & Scaling

Every month you receive a clear report showing what changed, what it produced, and what we're prioritising next. We track Google rankings, organic traffic, qualified lead volume, and AI citation rates — and we adapt the strategy to what's working. As results compound, we identify new opportunities to expand your visibility and outpace competitors who aren't keeping up. Outcome: a search strategy that grows in value over time, tied directly to revenue.

SEO & AI search
Is this an SEO agency or an AI agency?+

An SEO agency. The majority of every engagement is the work that has always moved rankings: technical health, on-page and content, backlinks, and local search. Google still sends far more traffic than every AI assistant combined, so it gets the majority of the hours. GEO and AEO are included on top because AI Overviews already sit above the organic results and buyers do ask assistants — but they are an extension of the SEO work, not a separate product we upsell.

Is AI search actually sending anyone to my site, or is this early hype?+

Direct referral traffic from AI assistants is still small compared with Google organic, and we won't pretend otherwise. The real effect is upstream: AI Overviews take clicks off results you already rank for, and assistants form a shortlist of brands before the buyer ever reaches a search page. That's why we fix Google rankings first and treat AI visibility as protection against that shift, not a replacement channel.

How do you measure something as fuzzy as “AI visibility”?+

We run a fixed set of your real buyer queries against ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews on a schedule, and log three things: whether you appear, how you're described, and who gets cited instead. That produces a score and a trend line you can watch move. It's sampling, not a complete census of every possible prompt — we're direct about that in every report.

Do I still need traditional SEO if I'm doing GEO and AEO?+

Yes, and anyone selling GEO as a replacement is selling you something. Language models lean heavily on what the wider web already says about you — crawlable pages, structured data, credible links, consistent entity signals. Those are the same things that rank you on Google. Do the SEO properly and you've built most of the AI visibility foundation at the same time, which is exactly how we sequence it.

Working together
How long before we see results?+

Technical and on-page fixes can move things within weeks. Meaningful ranking and traffic movement typically shows from month 3 to 6, and AI citation gains tend to follow authority work, so they build later and compound. Anyone quoting you a faster guaranteed timeline is guessing. You'll see the baseline and the first shipped work inside the first month either way.

What actually happens in the first 30 days?+

Week one and two: the full SEO audit, your AI visibility baseline, and a prioritized roadmap. Week three onward: technical fixes, on-page work, schema, and the first content and link-building going live. You get a working session with the strategist at the end of the month covering what shipped, what moved, and what's next.

Can you guarantee first-page rankings or a specific AI citation?+

No, and no honest agency can. Google weighs hundreds of signals and AI engines change their retrieval behavior without notice. What we commit to is a scoped strategy built on your real data, transparent monthly reporting including the months that didn't move, and consistent execution. If you've been promised a guaranteed number one, that's the promise to be skeptical of.

What if I already have an SEO agency?+

Plenty of clients start with the audit while an existing agency is still in place. It's a second opinion with no obligation. Sometimes it confirms they're doing solid work; more often it surfaces technical debt nobody prioritized, plus the AI-surface gaps a traditional scope was never built to cover. Whether you consolidate later is your call, not a condition of getting the audit.

Do I need an SEO consultant or an SEO agency?+

An SEO consultant typically works solo and suits businesses with a small, clearly scoped project — a one-off audit, a content review, or a technical fix list. An SEO agency brings a team: technical specialists, content strategists, link builders, and reporting — running in parallel across your site every month. If you want ongoing growth in rankings and traffic rather than a one-time fix, an agency engagement is usually the more effective structure. We offer both: the free audit is a consultant-style starting point, and the retainer is where the compound growth happens.

Pricing & logistics
How is pricing decided?+

Retainers run from $199 to $999 per month depending on site size, how competitive your category is, and how many surfaces are in scope. We scope after the audit rather than selling off a fixed menu, so you're paying for the work your site actually needs. The plans on this page are the common starting points, not a hard menu.

Am I locked into a contract?+

Engagements run month to month. Every account, property, and asset we touch is created in your name, so if you leave, the work and the data stay with you. The retention model is the results, not the paperwork.

Do you work outside the US, UK, and Australia?+

Yes. We run engagements across multiple countries and time zones, with reporting and calls scheduled around your working hours. Search fundamentals are largely global; local search work is always tailored to the specific market you're targeting.
